author_decision.primary_route: Retain all 12 source-eligible GSE80178 arrays as the primary analysis; do not delete any sample post hoc.
author_decision.outlier_disclosure: Explicitly identify GSM2114233 as a multi-metric QC outlier and carry the limitation into result interpretation and reporting.
author_decision.sensitivity_route: Run a separately labelled n=11 sensitivity analysis excluding GSM2114233 only, with raw-CEL RMA recomputed on the remaining 11 arrays and all other preprocessing, annotation, model, contrast, and multiplicity rules unchanged.
author_decision.diagnostic_reclassification: Treat the global minimum pairwise correlation and the 59.68% unique ENTREZ mapping fraction as review diagnostics rather than automatic rejection criteria; annotation yield is not evidence of individual-array failure.
author_decision.limitation_rule: Retaining GSM2114233 may support PASS_WITH_LIMITATION only after structural QC, independent validation, deterministic equivalence, and the prespecified n=11 sensitivity comparison are complete.
author_decision.no_other_exclusion: No sample other than GSM2114233 may be removed in the approved sensitivity route without a new author decision.

scope_control.l2_l3_handling: Preserve L2 and L3 v1 unchanged; create only a bounded derived sensitivity exception and a versioned M03 contract under this author lock.
scope_control.affected_module: M03_WITHIN_STUDY_EFFECTS and downstream modules that consume its accepted result

required_execution.comparison: saved deterministic script comparing equivalence plus all-12 versus n=11 effect direction, ranking, significance, and QC

preserve_do_not_modify: all accepted M01 and M02 results
